problem.description: Post-task audit found frozen startup and FunASR asset-path gaps
symptoms: The user-data videotrans directory could be absent when no static assets were bundled
FunASR remote_code pointed to the writable data root after frozen path separation

hypotheses.description: Configuration bootstrap assumes bundled assets created the user-data videotrans directory
FunASR helper was referenced by ROOT_DIR even though it is a bundle resource

tests_run.output: 5 passed after repair, including simulated frozen import from another CWD

findings: The frozen code path needs an unconditional writable config directory and a bundled path for filename-loaded scripts.

resolution.root_cause: Resource and data roots were previously conflated; the first split missed a required directory and a filename-loaded helper
resolution.fix_applied: Create the user-data config directory unconditionally, resolve FunASR helper via resource_path, and add its script to PyInstaller data
resolution.verification: Focused frozen-path tests and full 534-test suite pass; real extracted artifact smoke remains open
